$comment: Source of truth for vendored external skills. Pinned commits live in registry/skills.lock.json (the build INPUT). Adaptations live in overlays/<id>.json. Never edit plugins/<vendored>/ by hand.

marketplace.name: dfw-marketplace
marketplace.description: Design-first frontend workflow (dfw) plus pinned, de-conflicted copies of the design skills it orchestrates.

local.description: Design-first frontend workflow orchestrator: gates, studio, click-to-comment review, routing, checks.

skills.author: Anthropic
skills.role: Aesthetic base for every design phase
skills.description: Anthropic frontend-design: distinctive, intentional visual direction instead of templated defaults. Invoked by dfw.

skills.author: Anthropic
skills.role: Discovery (research planning, synthesis) and UX copy
skills.description: Anthropic UX research and UX writing skills: research plans, synthesis of findings, interface copy.

skills.author: Next Level Builder
skills.role: Data lookup: palettes, font pairings, product types, UX guidelines, charts (core skill only)
skills.description: UI UX Pro Max core skill: searchable local database of styles, palettes, font pairings, UX guidelines and charts (Python 3). Invoked by dfw as data, not as a decision maker.

skills.author: Paul Bakaus
skills.role: Critique, audit, polish, harden; detector used by dfw check
skills.description: Impeccable design commands (critique, audit, polish, harden, typeset, layout, ...) and its 62-rule detector. Hooks removed; telemetry and update checks disabled by dfw.

skills.author: Nutlope
skills.role: Lead for marketing/landing pages; sloplint used by dfw check
skills.description: Hallmark: anti-generic design skill for websites and landing pages, with sloplint. Invoked by dfw for marketing surfaces; edit hook not installed.

skills.author: Leonxlnx
skills.role: Reference mode only: website copy and section references + copy-lint
skills.description: Reference material from Taste (company-website copy, voice, sections, layout) and its copy-lint script. No hooks, no kit, no dealing scripts. Used by dfw as inspiration for marketing pages.
